name: ExpenseBot
description: Snap or forward a receipt — photo or PDF — and ExpenseBot reads it with AI, then drops the vendor, amount, date, tax, and category straight into your Google Sheet within seconds. From there, just ask: "How much did I spend on Uber last month?", "What's my profit by client this year?", or "Scan my Gmail for receipts I haven't logged." Capture expenses, run spending and P&L analytics on your own data, sweep Gmail for receipts, and build shareable expense reports for your accountant — all by chatting. OAuth 2.1 + PKCE, read-only by default with granular write scopes.

_published_faq.name: How do I add ExpenseBot to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add ExpenseBot to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.expensebot.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the ExpenseBot MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: ExpenseBot lists 40 MCP tools, including search_expenses, get_spending_summary, get_deep_analytics, create_report, list_reports, get_report_details, share_report, export_report, check_compliance, fix_compliance, check_tax_deductibility, and search_knowledge.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to ExpenseBot?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to ExpenseBot in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
ExpenseBot requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
ExpenseBot is developed by ExpenseBot. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
